author: rozaru
body:
* **InterPro ID / label**
IPR002202 and IPR009029

* **Example sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**
Hmgcr (fly)
HMGCR human, P04035 and homologs

* **Description of issue**
Could the current BP GO term “[coenzyme A metabolic process](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/QuickGO/term/GO:0015936)” be replaced with the more appropriate GO term “[isoprenoid biosynthetic process](https://flybase.org/reports/GO:0008299)”?
title: InterPro2GO issue: IPR002202 and IPR009029

author: blazaropinto
body:
Hi,
Thank you very much for this. I've updated this GO term in both entries. The changes will be available in the next InterPro release.
Best,
Beatriz
